How to play

Three rules. That's it.

  • 1You've got 60 seconds. The clock starts on your first keystroke, not before.
  • 2Backspace to fix a slip, but every miss still counts against your accuracy.
  • 3Buzzer hits or you finish the speech, whichever comes first. That's your score.
